name: HEZEKIAH
canonical: Hezekiah, the godly king of Judah, a dignified Hebrew man of middle years with olive skin and a well-kept dark beard, resolute righteous eyes, wearing a richly dyed blue-and-crimson royal robe with an embroidered hem and a simple gold circlet, a calm upright kingly bearing with his hands at his sides
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
